instruction: Complete the full FEniCS workflow from modeling to post-processing purely: 1. Write Python script `/home/user/Desktop/poisson_full.py`: - Create a `1×1` unit-square mesh with `64×64` cells - Define P1 Lagrange element - Define variational problem: `-Δu = sin(πx)*sin(πy)`, with boundary `u=0` - Compute L2 error (compared with known analytical solution) - Extract maximum nodal value 2. Run `poisson_full.py`. 3. Save L2 error and maximum nodal value to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: Format: `error_L2, max_nodal_value` [Software] Run your scripts with Python in an environment where dolfinx is installed (e.g. `import dolfinx`).
